content.Document Review and Approval: The Joint Committee appointed a peer review committee to review the document. The peer review committee was comprised of individuals nominated by ACC, AHA, and the collaborating organizations.
content.Scope of the Guideline: In developing the '2022 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Aortic Disease' the writing committee reviewed previously published guidelines.
content.Class of Recommendations and Level of Ev: The Class of Recommendation (COR) indicates the strength of recommendation. The Level of Evidence (LOE) rates the quality of scientific evidence.
